name: Omega-3 Fatty Acids
effects: Anti-inflammatory — competes with arachidonic acid in eicosanoid synthesis
DHA essential for brain structure and function; EPA more anti-inflammatory
Cardiovascular risk reduction — triglyceride lowering robust; mortality benefit debated
Investigated for depression, ADHD, cognitive decline, and dry eye
High doses (>3g EPA+DHA) have anticoagulant effect — caution pre-surgery
Fishy burps — enteric-coated or freeze-dried krill forms preferred
